scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chattar Sansodhit Yojna
other_conditions: Minimum academic performance for eligible caste groups: 70% for matric (urban) and 60% for matric (rural).
Minimum academic performance for eligible caste groups: 75% for 10+2 (urban) and 70% for 10+2 (rural).
Minimum academic performance for eligible caste groups: 65% for graduation (urban) and 60% for graduation (rural).
Backward Classes Block A students require 70% (urban) or 60% (rural) in matric.
Backward Classes Block B students require 80% (urban) or 75% (rural) in matric.
Meritorious students of other social classes receive scholarship at par with Block B criteria (80% urban, 75% rural) for matric.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of Rs 8,000‑12,000 per annum is awarded to meritorious students from class 11th to postgraduate level, with amounts varying by caste and education level.
